device.description: quad 10-bit voltage-output DAC with TMS320/SPI serial interface (FS frame sync), LDAC and power down
device.note: tlv5604.pdf (SLAS176B) p.1 (D/PW pinout, description), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: AVDD/DVDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, SCLK 20 MHz), p.7 (digital input timing requirements, Figure 1 timing diagram), p.12 (power-on reset, serial interface), p.13 (data format), p.14 (DAC select table)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A holding latch (A1 A0 = 00, p.14); power-on reset clears all latches (p.12)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B holding latch (A1 A0 = 01, p.14); power-on reset clears all latches (p.12)

registers.name: INC
registers.note: DAC C holding latch (A1 A0 = 10, p.14); power-on reset clears all latches (p.12)

registers.name: IND
registers.note: DAC D holding latch (A1 A0 = 11, p.14); power-on reset clears all latches (p.12)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A output latch; updated only while LDAC is low (p.3)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B output latch; updated only while LDAC is low (p.3)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC C output latch; updated only while LDAC is low (p.3)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC D output latch; updated only while LDAC is low (p.3)

registers.name: CTRLA
registers.note: internal: DAC A control bits D13 PWR (1 = power down) and D12 SPD (1 = fast) of its last write (p.13)

registers.name: CTRLB
registers.note: internal: DAC B control bits D13 PWR (1 = power down) and D12 SPD (1 = fast) of its last write (p.13)

registers.name: CTRLC
registers.note: internal: DAC C control bits D13 PWR (1 = power down) and D12 SPD (1 = fast) of its last write (p.13)

registers.name: CTRLD
registers.note: internal: DAC D control bits D13 PWR (1 = power down) and D12 SPD (1 = fast) of its last write (p.13)

commands.name: Write DAC A
commands.note: D15-D14 A1 A0 = DAC A, D13 PWR, D12 SPD, D11-D2 data, D1-D0 don't care (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC B
commands.note: D15-D14 A1 A0 = DAC B, D13 PWR, D12 SPD, D11-D2 data, D1-D0 don't care (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC C
commands.note: D15-D14 A1 A0 = DAC C, D13 PWR, D12 SPD, D11-D2 data, D1-D0 don't care (p.13-14)

commands.name: Write DAC D
commands.note: D15-D14 A1 A0 = DAC D, D13 PWR, D12 SPD, D11-D2 data, D1-D0 don't care (p.13-14)

protocol.note: FS falling starts the frame; data sampled MSB first on SCLK falling edges (SCLK idles high, Figure 1); after 16 bits the word moves to the DAC latch (p.12)

ldac.note: DAC outputs updated only while LDAC is low (p.3)

powerdown.note: powers down all DACs and output stages, active low (p.3)

pages: p.1 (D/PW pinout, description), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: AVDD/DVDD 2.7-3.3 V and 4.5-5.5 V, SCLK 20 MHz), p.7 (digital input timing requirements, Figure 1 timing diagram), p.12 (power-on reset, serial interface), p.13 (data format), p.14 (DAC select table)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs (x2 buffer), reference inputs REFINAB/REFINCD, settling speed (SPD) and per-DAC power down (PWR) effects

CS (chip enable, active low) is not modeled: the bus frame is FS (FS falling starts a word, as in the datasheet's 3-wire SPI connection with SS on FS and CS tied low, Figure 16); CS high does not block the model
a word cut short by FS rising before 16 bits (the datasheet moves the partial shift register to the DAC latch) is discarded
PD pin: the model also ignores the serial bus while PD is low (the datasheet does not say)
variants: tlv5604.pdf covers only the TLV5604 (C and I temperature grades).
